import numpy as np

# Load data from the attached file
file_id = '2026-08-07/T056.csv'
data = files[0]["table"]
x = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = data["intensity"]

# Calculate L2 norm
l2_norm = np.linalg.norm(y)
print(f"Original L2 norm: {l2_norm}")

# Normalize intensity vector
y_normalized = y / l2_norm

# Verify the new L2 norm
final_norm = np.linalg.norm(y_normalized)
print(f"Normalized L2 norm: {final_norm}")

# Save the normalized spectrum
saved_path = save_result('T056_l2_normalized', y_normalized, raman_shift=x)
print(f"Saved to: {saved_path}")
